description: Local interactive programming practice workbench turning Markdown tutorials into a split-pane learning environment with workspace explorer, Monaco+LSP editor, smart multi-terminal execution, selection-based context-aware AI tutor, and automated verification.

userStories.title: Initialize local workspace store and metadata schema
userStories.description: As a learner, I want each tutorial workspace to persist progress, notes, and settings in a local .codelab/ directory so that my learning state survives app restarts without polluting source files.
acceptanceCriteria: Define TypeScript/JSON schema for workspace.json, progress.json, and learning-log.json under <workspace>/.codelab/
Create workspace initializer that creates target directory and .codelab/ folder safely without overwriting existing user source files
Add atomic file read/write utilities with schema version migration guard
Unit tests cover new workspace creation, existing directory binding, and corrupted JSON recovery
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build Markdown tutorial semantic parser
userStories.description: As a learner, I want any standard Markdown tutorial (starting with the Go/GoFrame handbook) parsed into structured chapters, runnable command blocks, code snippets, acceptance checklists, and reflection questions.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse H2 headings into ordered Chapter/Exercise nodes with stable IDs
Identify bash/sh fenced blocks as runnable CommandBlocks and infer default cwd and daemon/oneshot mode from optional fence metadata or surrounding cd/go run heuristics
Extract bullet lists under 验收 headings as structured ChecklistItems and 思考 sections as ReflectionPrompts
Parse the 644-line Go/GoFrame README.md fixture cleanly into Exercises 0-9 with zero data loss
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pure parser module; supports both plain Markdown and optional fence attributes (cwd, mode, verify).

userStories.title: Implement local PTY multi-terminal manager backend
userStories.description: As a learner, I want the backend to spawn, track, and stream multiple real local shell sessions so that I can run long-lived servers and one-shot curl/test commands concurrently.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement TerminalManager supporting create, write, resize, interrupt (SIGINT), kill, and dispose operations via PTY
Track terminal metadata: id, title, cwd, status (idle | running | exited), lastExitCode, and ring-buffer of recent stdout/stderr (last 200 lines)
Detect active foreground child process so one-shot command dispatch routes to an idle terminal or spawns a new tab instead of writing into a busy daemon terminal
Cleanly terminate all child PTY process groups when workspace closes or app exits
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Must support macOS zsh/bash, Linux bash, and Windows PowerShell.

userStories.title: Implement dangerous command guardrail and preflight environment checker
userStories.description: As a local developer, I want dangerous shell commands intercepted for confirmation and required toolchains checked before starting exercises so that local execution is safe and predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement regex/AST-based risk classifier flagging destructive patterns (rm -rf, sudo, mkfs, dd, pipe-to-shell) with risk level and reason
Implement PreflightChecker probing tool versions (go >= 1.22, curl, git, gopls, gf) and GOPROXY reachability with 5s timeout per check
Return structured check status (pass | warn | fail) with actionable fix command hints
Unit tests verify risk rule matches and safe commands pass without false positives
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement real-time workspace file watcher and file CRUD service
userStories.description: As a learner, I want workspace files created by me or terminal commands to appear immediately in the file tree and support safe reading, editing, and saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement workspace filesystem service restricted strictly to the bound workspace root (reject path traversal outside root)
Watch workspace directory excluding .git, node_modules, and .codelab internals, emitting debounced change events within 500ms
Support listTree, readFile (with binary/size > 2MB guard), writeFile, createFile, renameFile, and revealInSystemExplorer
Unit tests confirm path traversal attempts (../) are blocked
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Required before code editor and artifact explorer UI.

userStories.title: Implement secure BYOK AI provider client and keychain credential store
userStories.description: As a privacy-conscious learner, I want to configure my own OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, or local Ollama endpoint with API keys stored in the OS keychain.
acceptanceCriteria: Store and retrieve API keys via OS credential vault (Keychain/Credential Manager); never write raw keys into .codelab/ JSON or logs
Implement unified streaming chat completion adapter supporting OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic APIs with AbortController cancellation
Provide testConnection() returning latencyMs and normalized error messages (401 invalid key, 429 rate limit, timeout, network unreachable)
Mask secrets in all error traces and telemetry payloads
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Offline mode must remain fully functional when no AI key is configured.

userStories.title: Implement AI four-dimensional context assembler and teaching prompt modes
userStories.description: As a learner, I want AI questions to automatically include my current exercise, selected code/error, and recent terminal output, with toggleable Socratic vs Direct teaching styles.
acceptanceCriteria: Assemble context payload from: (1) current chapter summary & rules, (2) user-selected snippet + file path + surrounding lines, (3) optional recent terminal output tail, (4) current checklist progress
Enforce deterministic token budget truncation (default max 6,000 input tokens) while prioritizing user selection and error tail
Support two system prompt modes: socratic (default guided coaching) and direct (full explanation with concise runnable examples)
Expose structured ContextChips metadata so UI lets users inspect and remove individual context items before sending
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002, US-003, US-005, US-006.

userStories.title: Build main workbench shell, welcome view, and built-in Go/GoFrame starter
userStories.description: As a first-time learner, I want a clean onboarding screen to import any Markdown handbook or launch the built-in Go/GoFrame tutorial into a resizable three-pane workbench.
acceptanceCriteria: Render Welcome screen with Open Local Markdown button, Built-in Go/GoFrame Course card, and Recent Workspaces list
Implement resizable split-pane workbench layout: Left (Interactive Manual + Outline), Center-Top (Workspace Explorer + Code Editor), Center-Bottom (Multi-Terminal Panel), Right Drawer (AI Tutor)
Persist pane sizes and collapse states across restarts
Display Preflight Check badge in top toolbar with popover details
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build interactive manual viewer with runnable command blocks
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to read chapters cleanly and click Run directly on bash blocks to execute commands in the right directory with live status feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Render chapter sidebar with completion indicators and smooth section navigation
Render bash/sh code blocks with target cwd pill, Run button, Run in New Terminal action, and Copy button
Trigger confirmation modal before executing commands flagged by US-004 risk classifier
Show inline execution state badge (Running / Exit 0 / Exit N) linked to the target terminal tab
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Connects US-002 parser output with US-003 terminal backend.

userStories.title: Build integrated xterm.js multi-terminal panel UI
userStories.description: As a learner, I want an embedded interactive terminal panel supporting multiple tabs, daemon stop/restart controls, and error selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Render xterm.js terminal instances bound to PTY streams with automatic ResizeObserver fit
Display tab bar with terminal title, cwd tooltip, running/idle/error indicator dot, and + New Terminal button
Show Stop (SIGINT) and Restart buttons on daemon tabs (e.g., go run .)
Provide Clear Output and Ask AI about Last Error quick actions in terminal header
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build workspace artifact file tree and Monaco code editor
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to browse my generated code artifacts and edit files with syntax highlighting and tabs inside the workbench.
acceptanceCriteria: Render collapsible file tree synced live with US-005 file watcher, highlighting recently modified files
Open files in Monaco Editor with multi-tab switching, dirty indicator dot, Cmd/Ctrl+S save, and syntax highlighting for Go, SQL, JSON, YAML, and Markdown
Support creating new files/folders from tree context menu and opening current file in configured external IDE
Show friendly placeholder state for binary or oversized (> 2MB) files
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate optional Go LSP (gopls) bridge into Monaco editor
userStories.description: As a Go learner, I want code completion, hover docs, and inline diagnostics when gopls is available on my machine, with graceful fallback when absent.
acceptanceCriteria: Spawn local gopls stdio process scoped to active Go module root (e.g., task-api/ or task-api-gf/) and bridge JSON-RPC to Monaco
Support textDocument/completion, textDocument/hover, and publishDiagnostics squiggles within 300ms on local files
Gracefully degrade to plain syntax highlighting with a non-blocking Install gopls hint when gopls binary is missing
Restart or shut down LSP child process cleanly when switching workspace or closing app
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MVP targets gopls first; interface remains language-agnostic for v1.1 expansion.

userStories.title: Build selection-based Ask AI floating toolbar across manual, editor, and terminal
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to highlight any confusing code, manual concept, or terminal error with my mouse and click Ask AI to get immediate contextual help.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect non-empty mouse text selection in Manual Viewer, Monaco Editor, and xterm.js Terminal
Show a compact floating action pill near the selection within 150ms without obscuring selected text, offering Explain, Diagnose Error (terminal/diagnostic context), and Custom Question
Clicking an action opens the right-side AI Tutor drawer with the selected snippet pinned as a quote card and auto-populated ContextChips
Dismiss floating toolbar cleanly on Escape, scroll, or outside click
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build AI Tutor chat drawer with streaming responses and mode toggle
userStories.description: As a learner, I want a dedicated AI Tutor panel that streams formatted answers, supports switching between Socratic and Direct modes, and lets me discuss reflection questions.
acceptanceCriteria: Render AI Tutor drawer with message history scoped per workspace/chapter, Markdown + code syntax rendering, and Copy Code buttons
Display removable ContextChips above input box showing attached chapter, file snippet, and terminal tail
Provide Socratic / Direct mode toggle persisted per workspace and Stop Generating button during streaming
Clicking Ask AI on a manual Reflection Question card pre-fills the question and evaluates the learner's reasoning
Show clear setup prompt linking to Settings when no AI provider is configured
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build chapter verification checklist and one-click automated check runner
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to check off acceptance criteria per exercise and run automated verification commands (like curl status checks or go test -race) with instant pass/fail feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Render Acceptance Criteria card at the end of each chapter with manual checkboxes persisted to progress.json
Support automated verification specs (exit code check, stdout/HTTP status assertion) runnable via a single Verify Exercise button
Display per-check pass/fail status, actual vs expected diff on failure, and a one-click Ask AI to Diagnose button
Update top progress bar and chapter outline completion badge automatically
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Ships built-in verification rules for Go/GoFrame Exercises 1-9.

userStories.title: Build Settings modal and local privacy controls
userStories.description: As a learner, I want a settings dialog to configure AI providers, default workspace directory, external IDE command, and clear local data.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide AI Provider tab with preset templates (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Ollama), masked API Key input, and Test Connection button
Provide Workspace & Editor tab for default folder, font size, theme (Dark/Light), and external IDE binary path
Provide Privacy & Data tab showing local storage path and Reset Progress / Clear AI History actions with confirmation
Persist non-secret settings locally and apply theme/editor preferences immediately without restart
Typecheck passes
